mandatoryCriteria: Existing CI retains pinned actions/Node/PostgreSQL, all tests/typechecks/builds and read-only GitHub permissions. New identity/People/OpenAPI checks run instead of silently skipping for a missing extra database.

Pinned Playwright tooling runs isolated synthetic browser checks, no real-account profile, credentials or hosted mutations. Harness creates/drops only its own schema in explicitly named loopback disposable database.

Lockfile plus package metadata resolve patched compatible PostCSS and Wrangler toolchain. Sanitized advisory lookup reports actual residual advisories; no major Next upgrade or fake zero-vulnerability claim.

Both Node and actual Worker regression suites, web static export and installed MCP artifact must pass using installed final locked dependencies. A package-lock-only resolution is not runtime verification.
Generated OpenAPI freshness is enforced in CI. Failed local/CI evidence is retained, and remote CI is not claimed until run. No production deployment or main branch protection mutation.
